note: Lifted NMOP model, compute/server fault domain. The RFC 9940 ladder separates what the legacy alarm conflates: an anomaly is a DEVIATION that may be benign; a fault is a confirmed occurrence; an alarm is a declared undesirable state; each anomaly carries a dynamic concern and confidence. ref=null marks a native concept with no legacy category.

concepts.label: resource
concepts.example: server node-14; the app container on it

concepts.label: event
concepts.gloss: a raw event on a resource at a moment, before interpretation
concepts.example: a threshold-crossing trap for CPU on node-14 at t0

concepts.label: anomaly
concepts.gloss: a deviation from expected behaviour that MAY be benign - not itself an undesirable state
concepts.example: a rising CPU-saturation trend on node-14 that may be an expected batch job

concepts.label: symptom
concepts.gloss: an observable manifestation of an underlying condition; a native NMOP notion
concepts.example: elevated request latency on the app container (a manifestation)

concepts.label: fault
concepts.gloss: a confirmed fault occurrence - the thing that has actually gone wrong
concepts.example: a failed cooling fan on node-14 (a confirmed fault)

concepts.label: alarm
concepts.gloss: a declared undesirable STATE requiring attention, distinct from the raw deviation

concepts.label: problem
concepts.gloss: a diagnosed problem behind one or more faults; a native NMOP notion
concepts.example: node-14 is thermally throttling under load (a diagnosed problem)

concepts.label: cause
concepts.gloss: a cause derived by CORRELATING events and anomalies, not a static code
concepts.example: a failed fan, derived by correlating the temperature and fan-speed readings

concepts.label: incident
concepts.gloss: an incident grouping related anomalies, faults and alarms; a native NMOP notion
concepts.example: the node-14 thermal incident grouping the temperature and CPU anomalies

concepts.label: concern-score
concepts.gloss: a dynamic concern score annotating an anomaly, recomputed from context - not a fixed severity
concepts.example: a concern score of 0.9 for the saturation outside the batch window

concepts.label: confidence-score
concepts.gloss: a confidence score on an anomaly's assessment; a native NMOP annotation
concepts.example: 0.7 confidence that the saturation is user-affecting
